articles.summary: The National Weather Service has issued an excessive heat warning from Tuesday to Wednesday that affects the PGE service area. With near-record high temperatures in the forecast, customers may be looking to stay cool and keep energy costs low.
articles.title: PGE shares ways to keep cool, reduce energy costs as hotter summer temperatures settle in

articles.title: Portland General Electric Reduced Power Outages by Nearly 25%
